journey.name: Brand and floating navigation on physical Android
journey.description: Verify the isolated correction on the installed production debug build without changing permission or reward data.

actions.action: Launch Super Nutrition from the newly built production debug APK.
Verify that Home and its selected Home tab are visible.
Verify that the green sprout replaces the first i dot in Super Nutrition.
Verify that Rewards is selected and Home is not selected.
Verify that tab label pixels retain their color while both icon tints change.
Verify that Rewards paper fills both sides of the floating navigation pill without an opaque full-width footer.
Verify that the held tab does not paint a rectangular background.
Scroll the Rewards list to its final card.
Verify that the complete final reward clears the camera action and navigation pill.
Verify that Home is selected and Rewards is not selected.
